title.zh: Mistral X Mozilla: Private, Multilingual AI Browsing
title.en: Mistral X Mozilla: Private, Multilingual AI Browsing

current_state.zh: Mistral and Mozilla announced a partnership to bring private, multilingual AI features—context-aware search, page summaries, and memory retrieval across tabs—to Firefox, launching in France and North America with a zero data retention policy.
current_state.en: Mistral and Mozilla announced a partnership to bring private, multilingual AI features—context-aware search, page summaries, and memory retrieval across tabs—to Firefox, launching in France and North America with a zero data retention policy.
